name: Ulezi Bora Academy Foundation
about: Ulezi Bora Academy Foundation is Kenya's premier institution dedicated to developing well-rounded student-athletes through our innovative dual-excellence approach in both sports and academics. Since 2013, we have been shaping the future of Kenyan football.
mission: To develop well-rounded student-athletes through innovative dual-excellence programs that combine world-class football training with comprehensive academic education, fostering character, leadership, and life skills that extend far beyond the pitch.
vision: To be Kenya's premier football academy, recognized globally for producing exceptional student-athletes who excel in sports, academics, and life, while contributing positively to their communities and society.
